   694	    """Resolve a repo-relative plan-command script against the consumer repo
   695	    root first, then the plugin root.

   697	    Returns ``(resolved_path, "")`` when the script stays canonical under one of
   698	    the roots and exists there. Otherwise returns ``(None, kind)`` where ``kind``
   699	    is ``"missing-script"`` when at least one root kept the path canonical (the
   700	    file is simply absent) or ``"non-canonical-path"`` when every root escaped
   701	    its tree. Checking both roots lets scripts that live only in the consumer
   702	    repo or only in the plugin cache pass the existence check (#4490).
   703	    """
   704	    roots = [repo]
   705	    if plugin is not None and plugin != repo:
   706	        roots.append(plugin)

   708	    for root in roots:
   709	        candidate = (root / script).resolve()
   710	        try:

   714	        canonical_seen = True
   715	        if candidate.is_file():
   716	            return candidate, ""
